text: This is to advise that the staff report on the 2018 Audited Financial Statements for The Board of Directors of the Hummingbird Centre for the Performing Arts (operating as Civic Theatres Toronto) will be submitted after the agenda has closed for the Committee meeting on February 11, 2020 but will be available for the meeting.
The TO Live Audit Committee withdrew Item RZ5.3 from the agenda.
